title: I made a football game controlled by scrolling. Looking for playtesters!
author: uxarya
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’ve been building [Scroll FC](https://scrollfc.vercel.app/), a free browser football game where scrolling moves your player forward and backward.

After some early feedback, I’ve improved the UI and gameplay and added more atmosphere with crowd buzz, terrace chants and other sound effects. You can play against the computer or invite a friend for a private 1v1 match.

I’d love feedback on the controls, game feel, sound and anything that seems confusing or unfinished.

**Play it here:** [Scroll FC](https://scrollfc.vercel.app/)

Desktop with a mouse or trackpad is recommended. Thanks for trying it!

**GenAI disclosure:** I’m a product designer and used GenAI as a development and coding tool. The concept, design decisions, testing and refinement were directed by me. GenAI is not part of the gameplay.
